newsitem.title: UK: UK machine tool turnover up 9.4% 3mths to Dec.
newsitem.headline: UK machine tool turnover up 9.4% 3mths to Dec.

text.p: Turnover of British machine tools increased by 9.4 percent in the three months to December versus the previous three, the Office for National Statistics said on Wednesday.
This was due to a 19.2 percent rise in export turnover and a 4.3 percent rise in home turnover. Compared with the same period last year, turnover fell by 1.4 percent, the ONS said.
Total orders on hand for machine tools at the end of December 1996 showed a 7.1 percent rise compared with the level at the end of September 1996 and was 8.4 percent up on December 1995.
